stem: Inez did laundry. She found $6.47 in the pocket of her dad's pants. Which of the following could NOT represent the amount of money Inez found?

options.label: F
options.text: Two $1 bills, four dimes, one quarter, two nickels

options.label: G
options.text: Two $1 bills, six dimes, two nickels, two pennies

options.label: H
options.text: Two $1 bills, one quarter, three dimes, two pennies

options.label: J
options.text: Two $1 bills, one quarter, two dimes, two nickels

difficulty_rationale: The problem requires adding different values of coins and bills to see which combination cannot equal $6.47, combining basic currency knowledge and addition skills.
